title: The 7th Continent
publicSourceReferences: Serious Poulp Official Explorer Guide & Rulebook
Community Survival Logs, Curse Playthroughs & Campaign Statistics

milestones.title: Castaway on Cursed Shores
milestones.description: Waking stranded on the uncharted shores of the continent, crafting rudimentary survival gear, and unearthing the first cryptic clues.

milestones.title: The Whispering Monoliths
milestones.phase: Expedition Phase II - Into the Heart of Peril
milestones.description: Navigating treacherous jungle canopies, discovering towering ancient effigies, and decoding stone glyphs that reveal the curse's true origin.

milestones.title: Banishment of the Voracious Goddess
milestones.phase: Expedition Phase III - The First Rite of Cleansing
milestones.description: Reaching the forbidden volcanic sanctuary, making the perilous offering, and purging the devastating spiritual malady.

milestones.title: Trial of the Predatory Hunt
milestones.phase: Expedition Phase IV - Masters of the Wilderness
milestones.description: Stalking legendary beasts through subterranean labyrinths and appeasing the gargantuan island guardians.

milestones.title: Sovereign of the Seventh Realm
milestones.phase: Expedition Phase V - Breaking the Final Shackles
milestones.description: Lifting all dark afflictions from your soul and charting an escape route back across the ocean to the civilized world.
